title: 第737章 敢问仙子芳名第736章 天地龙脉必将属于我大妖一族
slug: 人在合欢宗开局成为圣女道侣
content_zh:
第737章敢问仙子芳名？！
坠龙山脉外围，
陆尘正带着陆芽芽、瑶姬和长鱼梦然急匆匆地赶往那处神魔战场。
他们一路穿行，在嶙峋的山石之间，
昏黄的天光如梦似幻，
透过岩壁洒落下来，整座巨山宛若一幅褪了色的旧画。
风中，隐约带着一股说不清道不明的古老荒芜气息。
说来也怪，此山禁制极强，
根本无法御空飞行，只能靠着双脚一步一印地硬爬。
而且，山路陡峭，每走一段便要耗费不少灵力。
陆尘倒是轻松自如，
他体内根基深厚，灵力浑厚如海，这点消耗对他来说连皮毛都算不上。
可长鱼梦然就不行了，
走了没多远就开始气喘吁吁，脚步越来越沉。
一会儿喊累一会儿喊脚疼，更是借机发嗲撒娇，
频频往陆尘身上硬凑，
甚至还伸手挽住他的胳膊不放，嘴里还娇声娇气：
“叶大哥，梦然实在走不动了嘛，你就扶着人家走一段嘛……”
陆尘心头无奈，
再怎么着，她也是长鱼晚晴的妹妹。

算起来，还算是自己的未来小姨子。
这荒山野岭的，总不能真将她丢在后面不管。
就只得任由她紧紧贴了上来，
陆尘只感觉胳膊上，传来一阵温热柔软的触感，还带着一股若有若无的清甜香气。
他心头微微一荡，
那傲然柔软的触碰像是故意似的，
让他这个向来定力不稳的人，一阵心猿意马。
瑶姬虽然嘴上不说，但体内灵力也暗暗吃紧。
她虽魂体稳固、灵韵通透，可这山间禁制对她的压制却比旁人更重几分。
她的脚步也开始变得有些沉重。
陆尘看在眼里，没有说话，
只是微微侧身，
伸出一只手臂稳稳扶住她的柳腰，将她轻轻带向自己。
只有陆芽芽像是丝毫不受此山禁制的影响，依旧蹦蹦跳跳地走在最前头。
……
于是，就这样，
陆尘一左一右，右手扶着瑶姬，左臂被长鱼梦然紧紧挽着。
沿着蜿蜒向上的山路，长驱直入。
就在几人转过一处山坳时，
陆尘的脚步忽然微微一顿。

只见，
前方不远处，一行五人正沿着山道缓步而行。
四名女子分列前后，衣袂如云，身姿各异。
content_en:
Chapter 737 Dare you ask the fairy for her name? !
Outside the Dragon Falling Mountains,
Lu Chen was taking Lu Yaya, Yao Ji and Changyu Mengran to the battlefield of gods and demons in a hurry.
They walked all the way through the rugged rocks,
The dim skylight is like a dream,
Sprinkling down through the rock wall, the entire huge mountain looks like a faded old painting.
In the wind, there is a vague smell of ancient desolation that cannot be explained.
Strange to say, this mountain is extremely restrictive.
Unable to fly in the air at all, he could only crawl forward step by step with his feet.
Moreover, the mountain road is steep, and each step requires a lot of spiritual energy.
Lu Chen was relaxed and at ease,
The foundation in his body is deep, and his spiritual power is as thick as the sea. This consumption is nothing to him.
But Changyu Mengran couldn’t do it.
After walking a short distance, I began to pant and my steps became heavier and heavier.
Sometimes he complained that he was tired, and sometimes he complained that his feet hurt. He even took the opportunity to be coquettish and coquettish.
He repeatedly pressed hard against Lu Chen,
He even reached out to hold his arm and kept saying, coquettishly:
"Brother Ye, Mengran really can't walk anymore, so just help him walk for a while..."
Lu Chen felt helpless,
No matter what, she is also Changyu Wanqing's younger sister.
After all, she is still my future sister-in-law.
In this barren mountain, we can't really leave her behind.
I just had to let her stick close to me,
Lu Chen only felt a warm and soft touch on his arm, with a faint sweet fragrance.
His heart swayed slightly,
That proud and soft touch seemed to be intentional,
This made him, a person whose concentration was always unstable, feel confused for a while.
Although Yao Ji didn't say anything, her spiritual power was secretly tight.
Although her soul body is stable and her aura is clear, the restriction in the mountain suppresses her a little more than others.
Her steps also began to become a little heavy.
Lu Chen saw this and said nothing.
Just turn slightly sideways,
He stretched out an arm to hold her waist firmly and gently brought her towards him.
Only Lu Yaya didn't seem to be affected by the mountain's restrictions at all, and still jumped ahead.
…
So, just like that,
Lu Chen stood on the left and right, supporting Yao Ji with his right hand, and his left arm was held tightly by Changyu Mengran.
Follow the winding mountain road and drive straight in.
Just when a few people turned around a mountain col,
Lu Chen's footsteps suddenly paused slightly.
I saw,
Not far ahead, a group of five people were walking slowly along the mountain road.
Four women are arranged in front and back, with clouds of clothes and different postures.
